subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. The waking crew eat in the mess two decks down. The officers eat up here, behind a hatch, and Lou has a reason for wanting that stopped. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.line, version brandt+achebe (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: The Wardroom). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
